sense: be passed as fit, for a post, a profession or a contest

terms.gloss: to be approved as fit, pass the test
evidence: Plin. Ep. 10.30.2 (Trajan): quō prīmum probātī sunt, of recruits passed for service (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 7.63.6: ad ūnum Vercingetorīgem probant imperātōrem (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Probāre is to test and to approve a person as fit (Lewis & Short); the passive is to be passed as fit, as Roman recruits were. Using it of exams for a profession or of a qualifying round is our application. For “qualified” in the sense of fit or suitable, use idōneus with ad (Cic. Lael. 62: ad amīcitiam esse idōneus).

phrases.english: on the day they were first passed fit for service

sources: Lewis & Short: probo · Lewis & Short: idoneus
